venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH came in -13.9% vs target on Sunday ($1,854 net vs $2,153).** Food $291. Comps $23.70 (1.27%). 58 guests / $31.97 GCA. **A mostly good night cut short by a building evacuation** - the Neuhoff building fire alarm went off around 5:30 and everyone evacuated until 7, costing some sales, though most guests had already closed out. The team recovered well with members, regulars and new guests, and outstanding food sales. Annie trained and did a great job moving through the space, interacting with guests and executing cocktails. Kitchen: great food sales, smooth service. No incident; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: introducing Annie to the Sunday regulars and the fishmonger crew. MOD: KE/JMS. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR beat target +15.0% on Sunday ($10,750.36 net vs $9,352.12).** Segments: DC/AM $1,428.19 + D&C PM $9,322.17 (the Garden/6A field appears mis-keyed in the report - it duplicates the net total - so Garden is excluded here; net = AM + PM). Food $2,240.50. Comps $402.70 (3.75%). 173 guests (Tock). **A steady, manageable Sunday** - DC/AM had a great day with Kodi crushing the register and espresso bar, lots of breakfast and a cocktail pop at 2pm. Ran with two servers in the evening; outside of a small pop at open it was manageable all night, with the Garden taking the brunt of service. Kitchen: an epic Sunday with Rand and Antonio on dish. Break makeup complete; no-shows not charged; no injury. Favorite moment: a shout-out to Maggie H's eye for operations. MOD: Maggie H (AM) / Carey (PM). Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **DCEV beat target +4.7% on Sunday ($4,129 net vs $3,944).** Food $537 / Beverage $3,488 / Retail $40. Comps $81.90. 119 guests / $35 GCA. **Happy Pride!** - a brutally slow first turn gave way to blasts of demand from Pride crowds and service-industry veterans, with great anticipation from Dante on point. One large party, 7 solos, 119 covers. Top sellers: Native Lion, Rosalie, daiquiri, Burner Phone. Door: despite beautiful weather and the Pride parade, an incredibly slow start (lots of California IDs to chat with) until the room filled by 9:30 and felt energized; quiet finish after 11. Kitchen: great job. No-shows not charged. Maintenance: A/C condenser dripping badly. MOD: Thomas / Alejandro. Entered by T. (Report's date field was typed '6/27' but this is the 6/28 Sunday report.)

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **DCLA beat target +19.1% on Sunday ($5,396 net vs $4,530).** Marquee $5,396; Standing Room $0. Food $1,164. Comps $134 (birthdays, investors, DNL). 129 guests / $94.68 check avg. **A jumping Sunday** - started with 45 covers; lots of arts-district activity meant a decent early walk-in flow, room full by 8pm with a growing waitlist. The team burned and turned all night to clear and refill the list, then brought everyone down by 11pm for a strong last call. Drinks flowing, good energy, a few familiar faces - a busy Sunday to end the week. Kitchen: nice work. No-shows charged. MOD: Joe/Josh/Saleh. Entered by Joe.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DCDC came in -50.2% vs target on Sunday ($1,685.29 net vs $3,385.20).** Marquee bar $1,685.29; Garden $0. Food $122. Comps $30.80; voids $0. 40 guests (13 reservations / 27 walk-ins) / $36.64 GCA. **A rainy, hot, humid night with little foot traffic** and a light book to start. Quality guests though - Ben rocked the bar top solo with a few table touches; Tyler worked the floor and prepped for the week. Guest Sharona (newly moved to DC) had a blast; investor Steve Hauss was surprised with some Crown Royal. Savannah took down the garden's hanging ferns as it heats up. Kitchen: cookies were the win. No incident; no-shows not charged. Maintenance: well still leaking; curtains coming off rails. Favorite moment: guest Kelsie at the bar sharing about an NPR Tiny Desk concert. MOD: Marcus. Entered by Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.narrative: **Municipal beat target +26.3% on Sunday ($7,830 net vs $6,200).** Segments: AM bar $1,536 + PM bar $3,787 + Sun Club $327 + Hot Eye $1,840. Food $2,641. Comps $183. Event $0. 135 guests (57 AM / 78 PM). **A quiet brunch and a surprisingly steady night** - the usual post-church lunch crowd didn't show and AM was slow, so the team cut aggressively. Evening stayed steady to the end with a skeletal staff handling it well (Katie and Chandler big on glassware; Sam pulled a long shift). Sun Club: not bad for the heat. Hot Eye: empty until the 9pm bar crawl, then a steady flow and an 11pm wave of very intoxicated tourists plus a large service-industry group ordering rounds and shots for the whole bar - high energy and volume to close. Maintenance: pest control needed at THE (palmetto bugs arriving). No injury. Favorite moment: 45 mind erasers for the entire bar. Entered by Alexis.
